get.description: Lists the workspace's broker services. Requires an organisation admin; the caller also needs read authority on each service's environment history. Configs are returned without credential material.

post.description: Creates a broker service: one environment, one credential secret, kind http or mcp, and a policy of capabilities with optional path restrictions. The credential value is never accepted here; the service references a secret the environment already stores. Optimistic revisioning starts at 1. Control-plane mutations carry no dedicated audit event; invocations are audited.

403.description: Caller is not an organisation admin or lacks authority over the service's environment

put.description: Updates a broker service with an expected revision; a mismatch returns 409. Changing the environment or credential re-checks authority and the credential binding.

409.description: Revision conflict or missing expected revision

delete.description: Disables a broker service (config kept, enabled=false, revision bumped). Outstanding sessions for a disabled service stop passing session validation.

get.description: Lists live broker sessions for the workspace with subject, issuer, capabilities and expiry. Tokens are stored hashed and are never returned after issuance.

post.description: Issues a broker session (owb_ token shown once) bound to one service and one subject user, with an explicit capability list, TTL of 1-900 seconds, and optional approved privileged capabilities. The issuer needs broker:use and current authority over the service's environment and credential path; a restricted issuer cannot issue.

403.description: Disabled service, missing authority, or unapproved privileged capability

delete.description: Revokes a broker session immediately; the hashed token stops validating on the next dispatch.

get.description: Reads the broker audit trail (invoke attempts, decisions, durations). Workspace audit authority applies.

post.description: Executes one capability-scoped HTTP operation with an owb_ session token. Every dispatch revalidates the session, service revision, issuer authority and path policy, then proxies with the decrypted credential and projects the response to the capability's declared fields. Attempt and outcome are audited.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or stale session

post.description: Executes one tool call against a service-bound MCP endpoint with an owb_ session token, under the same revalidation, projection and audit rules as the HTTP executor. The request advertises both required Accept media types, but responses are consumed as JSON only; a server that answers with an SSE stream fails with a bad gateway.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or stale session
